items.a: medicalsupplie.com is an independent product discovery platform that helps you find everyday care and comfort products from six verified vendors. items.q: Do you sell products or provide medical advice?
items.a: No. We are an affiliate discovery site. You browse here and purchase on the vendor's official website. All product information is for general informational purposes only and is not a substitute for professional medical advice. Always consult a qualified healthcare professional for medical questions.

When you click a 'Shop at' link, you go to the vendor's website via an affiliate link. If you make a purchase, we may earn a commission at no extra cost to you. Affiliate links are marked with rel="sponsored" and we disclose this near recommendations and in our Affiliate Disclosure.

items.q: Do you show prices or inventory?
items.a: We do not display live prices, discounts, or inventory because they change frequently. The vendor's website always shows the most current pricing, availability, shipping, and return information.

items.q: What is the relationship between WalkHero and Wingood?
items.a: WalkHero is a consumer brand for orthopedic footwear. Public trademark records show GECKO MAN POWERED BY WALK HERO is owned by Fuzhou Winggood Technology Co., Ltd. WalkHero's official website is walkhero.com and focuses on arch-support shoes for men and women. Wingood appears to be the manufacturing/parent entity behind the WalkHero brand.

Verified catalog on walkhero.com includes orthopedic shoes with targeted arch support and orthotic insoles, walking shoes, slippers, sandals, and models marketed for plantar fasciitis, flat feet, heel pain, and all-day comfort. The vendor emphasizes cushioning, stability, and alignment support.

Eydology (eydology.com) is an eyewear retailer based at 244 Madison Ave, NY 10016 (operated by MATCH PLUS INC). Verified categories include optical glasses, prescription glasses, blue-light glasses, cat-eye, aviator, and AI smart glasses with camera and audio, photochromic lenses, and sunglasses. They offer virtual try-on and PD measurement tools.

Eydology allows selection of lenses with prescription information including PD. Prescription details are personal health information handled per their Privacy Policy. Always confirm your prescription with your eye care provider. Official site: https://eydology.com.

FullscopeMD (fullscopemd.com) describes itself as a U.S. telehealth patient-support platform connecting patients with independent licensed providers. It does not diagnose, prescribe, manufacture, or dispense itself. Verified programs listed include branded GLP-1 medications information, hormone therapy, medical weight management, hair loss evaluation, wellness therapy, sexual health evaluation, and acute care support.

According to their site, the process moves from online request to independent provider review, pharmacy fulfillment when prescribed, and follow-up support. Clinical decisions are made by independent licensed providers, and licensed pharmacies handle fulfillment. Address: 30 N Gould St Ste N, Sheridan, WY 82801. Official site: https://www.fullscopemd.com. This information is general and not medical advice.
